scope.scheduled_paid_offer: GitHub Assurance Seat: a customer-managed per-seat operating package for GitHub pull-request proof

value_contract.buyer_outcome: A named contributor can attach deterministic, commit-bound proof context to a GitHub pull request without making Code Factory a merge authority or a source-code host.
included_when_activated: commit-bound GitHub Proof Review Check and walkthrough
human-approved Plan-to-Proof scope envelope and visible Proof Debt
supplied-policy drift dossier bound to the exact commit and named expiring exceptions
organization-authored policy bundles with named, expiring exception receipts
exportable hash-bound evidence, attestations, and review packets
customer-managed local evidence and no Code Factory source upload
value_contract.commercial_rationale: The seat pays for a maintained, governed assurance operating package, not for access to the open-source repository or for opaque AI-token resale.
does_not_include: automatic merge, release, deploy, approval, or policy bypass authority
hosted evidence retention, managed execution, or source-code hosting
SOC 2 or other compliance certification, SSO/SCIM, external KMS, or SLA
AI model quota, token credits, or a claim that a test has run when no receipt exists

activation_rule: All G1-G6 gates require dated evidence, a feature-by-feature availability matrix, and product-owner approval before any paid offer, checkout, entitlement, or access claim is activated.
